Zone 3 (hub_camp) = the zone 1 near rows (Props, Boulders, WorldNear, WorldEdge) shifted by z + 72.00, ids z3_*, split into ring groups by distance from the entry (0, 72.00) at [26.0, 44.0] m. Same libraries, same lodProfiles: every mesh and material is SHARED with zone 1. The flagstone floor is copied (rules.skipLibraries). Rows in the door walk, behind the entry or in a later zone are dropped (rules.*). lodProfiles.name: sky_ridge
lodProfiles._about: LOD0/LOD1 can never be selected (screen height cannot exceed 1 for a ridge in view at 10x), so every ridge is the 2.5-3.2k tri LOD2 and is never culled by size

lodProfiles.name: sky_ruin
lodProfiles._about: far_ruin LOD1 (2.6-3.3k tris) while a tower fills > 30 % of the screen height, else LOD2 (0.75-1.2k tris); LOD0 (20 MB glb) only if one fills the whole screen

props.rationale: Planted banner pole (3 m, cairn base) right of the doorway, in front of the gate face (z 27); heavy mesh (54k) so hero_heavy LOD. Unity-space suggestion, NOT checked against terrain.

flush flagstone paving: stone tops average y 0 (terrain lane is -0.05), x +-4 z 0..22.6 with a ragged broken edge fading into the ground, no lip. Authored in WORLD coordinates (bounds y about -0.4..0): ground=pivot means place with the model origin on pos, do NOT lift the bounds bottom to pos.y.
